column2: Letter Flip. Look, listen, and learn. Choose Play, How to Play, or Settings.

Choose normal or backwards. Practice has no chance limit. Challenge uses your chance limit. After a mistake, see the answer. O, zero, and eight look the same in a mirror. These shapes are always normal. Set games, sound, and controls together in Settings.
Press A for normal. Press B for backwards. Press Start to pause. Press Z to hear the voice again.
Hold the Wii Remote upright. Press A for normal. Press B for backwards. Press Plus to pause. Press Minus to hear the voice again.
Hold the Wii Remote sideways, with the direction pad on the left. Press Two for normal. Press One for backwards. Press Plus to pause. Press Minus to hear the voice again.
Let us look together. This card is normal. You can learn with each try.
Let us look together. This card is backwards. You can learn with each try.
Round complete. Thank you for trying! Choose Play Again to try another round, or Menu to return.
Take a break. Your round is waiting.
Change controller. Select with the controller you want to use.
Practice. You can learn without losing chances.
Chance limit. This is for Challenge. Practice does not lose chances.
Practice cards. Practice ends after this many cards.
Mirror shapes. Only shapes with a visible mirror.
Review time. Time to look at the answer before the next card.
Upright. A for normal, B for backwards.
Sideways. Two for normal, One for backwards.
Preview sound. Good job! You can learn with each try.
Retry save. Insert a memory card, then select to try again.
Saving. Keep the memory card inserted.
The save failed. Your settings and scores are still here for this session. Use Retry Save in Settings.
No memory card. Your settings and scores are for this session.
A saved record was recovered. A damaged file was preserved. Saving is blocked.
Connect a controller. Your round will wait.
